result:
I'd make people fundamentally more curious and less tribal.

Not "smarter" in the narrow IQ sense, and not more "kind" in the vague, moralizing way people usually say. Just a shift where the default human impulse is to understand how things actually work—physics, biology, other people, systems—rather than to protect their group, their status, or their existing beliefs.

Most of the world's worst problems aren't caused by a lack of resources or technology. They're caused by people being trapped inside self-reinforcing stories that feel more important than reality. If that drive flipped even modestly, a lot of the downstream damage (pointless conflicts, institutional rot, self-destructive politics, scientific stagnation) would become much harder to sustain.

Everything else—cooperation, long-term thinking, actual progress—would probably follow from that single change more reliably than from trying to fix the symptoms one by one.
